title: Nutty Midnight Craving Bouncy Jamaican Cornmeal Stew
description: A delicious and comforting Jamaican-inspired stew that's perfect for a midnight craving. The cornmeal adds a delightful nutty flavor and a fun bouncy texture.
instructions: Heat oil in a hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the pork sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the flour and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually add the water, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cornmeal and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cornmeal is tender.
Stir in the beurre monte, shredded coconut, cocoa nibs, grated ginger, nutmeg, cayenne pepper, black pepper, and salt.
Cook for an additional 1 minute, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Serve hot in the hot pot vessel.
Let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
This will allow the flavors to meld together and the cornmeal to absorb any excess liquid.
Serve hot, garnished with additional shredded coconut if desired.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
Reheat in the microwave or on the stovetop, adding a splash of water if the stew becomes too thick.
Serve in bowls or as a filling for sandwiches.
Use leftover cornmeal to make cornbread or corn cakes.
Experiment with different spices and ingredients to create unique variations of this recipe.
Don't be afraid to get creative and make it your own!
